description: Defines the NodeCapabilityRouter class responsible for routing commands to appropriate handlers based on command strings. Contains error handling for unknown commands and maintains a dictionary of handlers.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A class that routes commands to their respective handlers based on command identifiers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the router with a dictionary of handlers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a request by invoking the associated handler for the command, throws an error if command is unknown.
